slides.heading: elif Chains
slides.body: elif Chains is part of Conditional Execution. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: elif Chains
slides.body: An elif chain checks several conditions in order. Python runs the first matching branch and skips the rest.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: elif is like choosing from several doors. The first door that fits the condition is opened.

slides.body: A conditional needs a colon, correct indentation, and a condition that clearly evaluates to True or False.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Use if-elif-else to classify a temperature as Hot, Warm, or Cold.
slides.hint: Check the highest condition first, then the next.
